data.desc: CCU is a multi-category beverage company with operations in Chile, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Paraguay, and Uruguay. With over 115 years of history, CCU has a long business tradition, being one of the largest players in each of the categories in which it participates in Chile and the second-largest brewer in Argentina. Over the years, the company has achieved profitable and sustainable growth by creating valuable experiences for the people it interacts with and demonstrating a genuine commitment to the planet. Our culture is our identity, and it is defined under the concept of BEING CCU, which seeks to answer the questions: What inspires us, What we are like, How we do it and For whom we work.
